profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at The Home Depot
profile.summary:
As a computer science student at Georgia State University I had the pleasure of incorporating my programming skills for the Pi chapter of Alpha Kappa Psi by updating and maintaining the personal website. While maintaining the website I was able to teach myself javascript and jquery. I am also implementing a database for the fraternity to withhold information of its members.

During my spring 2011 semester at Georgia State I interned with memberclicks as a Software Engineer and was granted the opportunity to learn j2ee framework, spring mvc, as well as php. The internship improved my critical thinking skills and communication skills through the utilization of the scrum process.

Currrently I am seeking to continue my love and passion for java Web development, but I am also open to learning new languages and applying my skills to further help businesses succeed in their goals.

Specialties: Java, C, Oracle 11g, Pl/SQL, mySQL, Unix, GUI's, Objective C, Object Oriented designs, PHP, SpringMVC, Hibernate

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently utilizing my skills in java, angular JS, and html to develop an exceptional Monitoring system for cash based devices (eg. cash registers, atms, etc.).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Use knowledge my knowledge of java to build web applications as well as multi-threaded back end applications to further help our data team process geo location data efficiently and accurately.

positions.title: Independent Business Owner
positions.description:
Provided service to Customers and provided products according to their needs.
Attended educational meetings every week on generating volume.
Work in a team with other IBO's to provide new innovative ideas on how to increase customer volume.

positions.title: Engineering intern
positions.description: As an intern I developed new skills in programming such as using php as a server side language for web development as well as calling java delegate classes in a php file. I incorporated my java skills into learning how to develop we applications using struts and jsp's. While I was an intern I had the opportunity to learn about hibernate and spring mvc as well as implement them into the new architecture.

Demonstrated great interpersonal skills while speaking to customers
